density/thickness compliance check Download ExcelDownload PDF **20** Checkpoints **7** Sections 1 test per 250-500m²; per pavement layer; minimum 3 cores per section Testing Laboratory, QC Engineer [IS 2720:1973](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720-Part-2-1973) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) [ASTM D2726:2017](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2726-1988) Related [📐IS 2720](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Earthwork Bulking & Shrinka…](https://infralens.in/handbook/earthwork-bulking) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧RCC design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. CORE EXTRACTION & VISUAL INSPECTION | | A1 | Core extracted perpendicular to pavement surface; diameter 100mm standard
Acceptance: Diamond bit drilling; perpendicular to surface; 100mm dia standard; clean extraction | Cl. 503 — Extraction method | | | A2 | Core visually inspected for layer separation, cracks, segregation, or contamination
Acceptance: Layers bonded without gaps; no cracks >2mm; uniform material distribution; documented with photos | Cl. 503 — Visual assessment | | | A3 | Individual layer thicknesses measured with precision ruler; recorded to 0.5mm
Acceptance: Each layer thickness ±2mm; total thickness recorded; compared to design | Cl. 503 — Thickness measurement | | | B. BULK DENSITY TESTING | | B1 | Core saturated surface dry (SSD) condition achieved; core soaked in water 4-24 hours
Acceptance: Core submerged in water tank at 20-25°C; 4-24 hour soak; surface dried with cloth | Cl. 503 — Sample preparation | | | B2 | Core mass measured in SSD condition and dry condition (after oven drying at 110°C)
Acceptance: SSD mass recorded to ±1g; dry mass after oven drying 24 hrs at 110°C ±5°C | Cl. 503 — Mass measurement | | | B3 | Bulk density calculated: Bulk Density (kg/m³) = Dry Mass / Volume
Acceptance: Volume measured by displacement or caliper; density ±20 kg/m³ precision | Cl. 503 — Density calculation | | | B4 | Bulk density compared to Marshall density and field requirement (≥98% Marshall)
Acceptance: Field density ≥98% Marshall; if <98%, section flagged for re-compaction | Cl. 503 — Density compliance | | | C. LAYER THICKNESS VERIFICATION | | C1 | Measured layer thickness compared to design specification; tolerance ±10mm (or ±5%)
Acceptance: Design ±10mm acceptable; <90% design requires material addition; >110% acceptable | Cl. 503 — Thickness compliance | | | C2 | Total pavement thickness (all layers) verified; thickness variation recorded
Acceptance: All layers combined match design ±5% variation allowed across 100m section | Cl. 503 — Total thickness | | Showing 9 of 20 checkpoints ·View all → A. CORE EXTRACTION & VISUAL INSPECTION A1Core extracted perpendicular to pavement surface; diameter 100mm standard Cl. 503 — Extraction method (SP 20) ✓ Diamond bit drilling; perpendicular to surface; 100mm dia standard; clean extraction A2Core visually inspected for layer separation, cracks, segregation, or contamination Cl. 503 — Visual assessment (SP 20) ✓ Layers bonded without gaps; no cracks >2mm; uniform material distribution; documented with photos A3Individual layer thicknesses measured with precision ruler; recorded to 0.5mm Cl. 503 — Thickness measurement (SP 20) ✓ Each layer thickness ±2mm; total thickness recorded; compared to design B. BULK DENSITY TESTING B1Core saturated surface dry (SSD) condition achieved; core soaked in water 4-24 hours Cl. 503 — Sample preparation (ASTM D2726) ✓ Core submerged in water tank at 20-25°C; 4-24 hour soak; surface dried with cloth B2Core mass measured in SSD condition and dry condition (after oven drying at 110°C) Cl. 503 — Mass measurement (ASTM D2726) ✓ SSD mass recorded to ±1g; dry mass after oven drying 24 hrs at 110°C ±5°C B3Bulk density calculated: Bulk Density (kg/m³) = Dry Mass / Volume Cl. 503 — Density calculation (ASTM D2726) ✓ Volume measured by displacement or caliper; density ±20 kg/m³ precision B4Bulk density compared to Marshall density and field requirement (≥98% Marshall) Cl. 503 — Density compliance (SP 20) ✓ Field density ≥98% Marshall; if <98%, section flagged for re-compaction C. LAYER THICKNESS VERIFICATION C1Measured layer thickness compared to design specification; tolerance ±10mm (or ±5%) Cl. 503 — Thickness compliance (SP 20) ✓ Design ±10mm acceptable; <90% design requires material addition; >110% acceptable C2Total pavement thickness (all layers) verified; thickness variation recorded Cl. 503 — Total thickness (SP 20) ✓ All layers combined match design ±5% variation allowed across 100m section Showing 9 of 20 ·View all → Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS REJECTED — RE-COMPACT REQUIRED Test Conducted By Name / Sign / Date Reviewed By Name / Sign / Date Lab Head Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
